title: Object Storage: the tier rounding convention
content:
Object Storage the tier rounding convention is defined as follows: Decimal tie-breaking convention for monetary and quantity rounding; string.

| Contract tier | The tier rounding convention |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | the tier rounding convention: half-up |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the the tier rounding convention entry is half-up.
